Check key player availability for a team

Source: R/data_transfers.R
key_players_unavailable.Rd

Determines if a team's most valuable players are available by cross-referencing squad values with injuries and suspensions. Useful as a predictive feature.

Usage

key_players_unavailable(
  team,
  injuries_df,
  suspensions_df,
  squad_values_df,
  top_n = 5L
)

Arguments

team

Character. Team name (must match Transfermarkt spelling).

injuries_df

A tibble from fetch_league_injuries().

suspensions_df

A tibble from fetch_league_suspensions().

squad_values_df

A tibble from fetch_squad_values() with player-level data (requires player_name and market_value_eur).

top_n

Integer. Number of top players to check (default 5).

Value

A list with n_unavailable, unavailable_value_eur, pct_value_missing, key_players_out (character vector).
